_policy_texts.text: Source of funds documentation is required for expected deposits above $10,000 or when funds origin is inconsistent with the customer profile.
PEP matches require escalation to the EDD team before any approval, unless the match has been resolved as a false positive.

A screening match may be resolved as a false positive only when at least two identity attributes affirmatively mismatch, and the rationale must be recorded in case notes before proceeding. Never applies to sanctions matches.
